english.title: Make to the registrar a statement that is misleading / false / deceptive in a material particular
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly made a statement to a registrar of companies for England and Wales that was misleading, false or deceptive in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY MATERIAL PARTICULAR..)

english.notes:
(i) This offence document applies from the 4th March 2024 to a penalty amendment made by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For the offence applying before this date, see H14695. (ii) This is the aggravated form of this offence, for the basic form of this offence, see H101608.
(iii) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar as an alternative to prosecution for this offence, being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006.
(iv) Civil financial penalties may be issued by the registrar for this offence being a ‘relevant offence’ as defined by section 1132A of the Companies Act 2006. No criminal proceedings may be commenced against a person in respect of conduct amounting to an offence if the person has already been given a financial penalty by the registrar. Further, no financial penalty may be imposed on a person in relation to conduct amounting to an offence if proceedings in respect of that offence are ongoing or the person has been convicted.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.
The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
